caseStudies.title: Custom CRM - Sales Pipeline and Performance System
caseStudies.shortSummary: Designed and implemented a custom CRM platform to centralize sales pipeline visibility and performance tracking.
caseStudies.problem: Sales activity and performance tracking were split across disconnected documents, making weekly reviews and decision-making slow.
constraints: Needed to fit an existing operational process without stopping active sales work.
Required role-based access and stable reporting behavior for managers and contributors.
Had to run on controlled infrastructure with clear deployment ownership.
approach: Mapped pipeline stages and reporting requirements before implementation.
Built the backend workflow and data model in Laravel with PostgreSQL.
Implemented the operator-facing interface in Next.js and containerized deployment with Nginx and Docker.
result: Created one source of truth for pipeline and performance review.
Reduced coordination overhead between sales and leadership during weekly check-ins.
Delivered a system that can be extended with additional sales operations modules.

caseStudies.title: RRI Android App - AI Chat and Search UX
caseStudies.shortSummary: Improved AI chat entry and search behavior by implementing recommendation bubbles and state correctness handling.
caseStudies.problem: Users needed a clearer path from AI chat entry to relevant search actions, while preserving state consistency across interactions.
constraints: AI chat needed to be integrated through a WebView entry point in an existing Android flow.
State transitions had to remain consistent across user taps, suggestions, and search results.
Changes had to ship without destabilizing the existing app behavior.
approach: Implemented WebView-based AI chat entry aligned with the current navigation model.
Added recommendation bubbles to reduce decision friction for first actions.
Refined state handling logic to keep selected intents and resulting queries synchronized.
result: Delivered a cleaner AI-assisted discovery flow for mobile users.
Improved UX consistency by addressing state mismatch edge cases.
Provided implementation notes to support future feature iteration.

caseStudies.title: IndoGate Monorepo - Admin, Landing, and API
caseStudies.shortSummary: Consolidated product surfaces into a monorepo architecture with Next.js frontend apps and a NestJS API.
caseStudies.problem: Separate repositories for dashboard, landing page, and backend API created dependency drift and release overhead.
constraints: Multiple app surfaces needed independent delivery while sharing core standards.
Team workflows required clear boundaries between frontend apps and backend services.
Tooling had to stay simple for contributors using npm workspaces.
approach: Structured the project using npm workspaces with dedicated app and service packages.
Standardized scripts and conventions for local development and CI-friendly execution.
Implemented Next.js AdminDashboard, Next.js Landing, and NestJS API within one coordinated repository.
result: Reduced release friction across related surfaces by unifying repository management.
Improved consistency in dependency updates and shared engineering conventions.
Enabled more predictable collaboration between product and engineering contributors.

caseStudies.title: Automation Workflows - n8n, GAS, and API Integrations
caseStudies.shortSummary: Built operations automations for order logging and WhatsApp tracking pipelines using n8n and Google Apps Script.
caseStudies.problem: Operational logging tasks were manual, repetitive, and prone to inconsistencies between communication channels and spreadsheets.
constraints: Workflows needed to be understandable by non-technical operations users.
Integrations had to stay resilient when third-party payloads changed.
Error handling needed to preserve auditability for operational reviews.
approach: Implemented web order to sheet workflows with validation and normalization steps.
Added WhatsApp to sheet logging and tagging automations for tracking continuity.
Used n8n and Google Apps Script to balance flexibility, speed, and maintainability.
result: Reduced manual copy-paste effort in daily operations.
Improved consistency of log records across channels.
Provided reusable automation patterns for future workflow extensions.

caseStudies.title: HYPPE UI Fixes - Social Cards Polish
caseStudies.shortSummary: Refined social card UI behavior and styling consistency to improve readability and perceived quality.
caseStudies.problem: Feed card presentation had inconsistent spacing and visual hierarchy, reducing clarity in dense content lists.
constraints: Fixes had to fit into an existing design language without broad redesign scope.
Changes needed to avoid regressions on multiple device widths.
Implementation had to be low-risk for production rollout.
approach: Reviewed card-level spacing, typography rhythm, and interaction cues.
Applied focused UI refinements for better readability and alignment consistency.
Verified behavior across representative mobile and desktop viewport ranges.
result: Delivered cleaner and more consistent social card presentation.
Improved scannability of feed items for faster user comprehension.
Prepared UI foundation for future feature additions with less visual debt.
